title: Cosmic selected artwork and portable production provenance
status: Complete source and mechanical export selection: 245 icons and 16 backgrounds. Art review verdicts are recorded separately by the study.
generator: Built-in image_gen tool exclusively; Python operations only crop, mask, resample, assemble reference material, and encode generated raster artwork.
metadata_limits: No model identifier or per-generation timestamp is asserted. Existing requests and extraction files retain their historical contents. For space backgrounds, sent_tool_arguments is the exact recorded generation call and takes precedence over the earlier request plan. The pilot text retains its exact prompt, not a complete tool-call envelope.

path_conventions.production_paths: Relative to this file and portable with the entire production directory.
path_conventions.runtime_paths: runtime is repository-relative after promotion; asset_relative_path is relative to the runtime assets directory supplied to export-selected.py --verify-assets.
path_conventions.historical_paths: Existing request/extraction paths are provenance, not current filesystem instructions. Resolve the original projects/cosmic-study/production/ prefix (also within old absolute machine paths) relative to this directory; aliases below retain necessary scratch references.
path_conventions.unretained_generated_cache: source_path and rejected candidate locations in historical records refer to the original tool cache. Selected master bytes are retained here; rejected candidates and cache paths are not required for exports.
path_conventions.selected_runtime_references: Reference inputs with scope selected-runtime-asset resolve through the matching selected asset_id and its existing runtime file, or its mechanical replay. The hydrated-embryo request uses three existing final icons; no duplicate reference copies are retained.

recognition_limit: At 72px the art supports family and state distinctions; exact species, invisible mechanisms and conditions remain dependent on ordinary labels and readings. Provenance and mechanical checks do not establish recognition or human enjoyment.

export_environment.note: Versions observed while verifying byte-for-byte mechanical replay; this is not generation model metadata.

operations.circular-rim-v1: RGBA EXTENT transform of recorded floating bounds to 1152x1152 using BICUBIC; intersect existing alpha with an ellipse whose margin is 1152*((rim_radius+2)-rim_radius-0.1)/(2*(rim_radius+2)); LANCZOS resize to 288x288; PNG optimize=true.
operations.rgba-crop-resize-v1: RGBA integer crop with recorded widened bounds, then LANCZOS resize to 288x288; preserve source alpha, no added mask; PNG optimize=true.
operations.rgba-png-resave-v1: Retained 288x288 RGBA pilot crop re-encoded as PNG optimize=false, without pixel changes.
operations.rgb-fit-resize-v1: RGB LANCZOS resize to 780x1688 using the exact floating centre-fit crop box recorded in the background extraction; WebP quality=88, method=6. For coast backgrounds 13, 14 and 16 this is only a nominal reconstruction: their historical record does not specify the resampling kernel or fully reproduce final bytes.

assets.replay_limit: The original record retains analytical centre-fit bounds and WebP quality88/method6 but does not specify the exact resampling/encoding sequence. Standard Pillow fit, crop and resize variants did not reproduce these final bytes. The replay uses the recorded floating bounds with LANCZOS as a nominal reconstruction; the selected runtime and source hashes remain authoritative.
